title: The Marvel Saga #6 Marvel 1986 X-Men X-Factor Origins Cyclops Iceman Iron Man
conditionDescription: Front cover clean with light edge wear. Back cover has tape over a scuffed area on the Iron Man figure. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Marvel Saga: The Official History of the Marvel Universe #6 (May 1986), Marvel 25th Anniversary. X-Men and X-Factor origins continue: Cyclops and Iceman, plus the origins of Iron Man, the Puppet Master and Alicia, and Odin and Asgard. Wraparound cover by Brent Anderson and Joe Sinnott. Direct edition, $1.00 cover price.

Condition: front cover clean with light edge and corner wear. Back cover has a piece of tape over a scuffed/torn area on the Iron Man figure (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
